mapper.select: SELECT t.slug AS tag, COUNT(DISTINCT a.id) AS articleCount, MAX(COALESCE(a.published_at, a.created_at)) AS latestAt FROM tags t JOIN article_tags atg ON atg.tag_id = t.id JOIN articles a ON a.id = atg.article_id AND a.deleted = 0 AND a.status = 'published' WHERE t.deleted = 0 GROUP BY t.slug ORDER BY articleCount DESC, t.slug ASC
